prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1017; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism, including the direction of impact and the force involved, is consistent with the concussion diagnosed at intake, and the symptoms described at presentation align with that mechanism. Over the course of 16 visits, care followed a typical progression, beginning with symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive assessment, and graded activity guidance, then tapering in frequency as the patient's headaches, light sensitivity, and concentration difficulties improved. Imaging and neurological examination findings clearly support the diagnosis. The patient reports no prior injury to the head or neck region, and none appears in available records. Billing records show two similar charges submitted on the same day, which are currently under review to confirm they reflect separate, appropriate services. Current status is improving, with return to work planned pending final reassessment.
